summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and major investments in the retail and tech sectors, reflecting ongoing regulatory and market developments.

bullets.text: Supreme Court ruled its April 2026 directions on National Highway encroachments do not override statutory safeguards until High Courts decide.
Reliance and Jio plan to invest Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years for India's AI transformation, according to Mukesh Ambani.
P&G Home reported a FY'26 profit dip of 2.7% to Rs 664.8 crore, despite a revenue increase of 3.4% to Rs 9,359.34 crore.
GIVA raised Rs 90 crore from BlackSoil to fund expansion into gold and lab-grown diamond categories, enhancing its retail presence.
India's semiconductor market is projected to reach $100-110 billion by 2030, indicating significant growth potential in the tech sector.
